channel.title: YA Transit News & Insights
channel.description: Plain-English news and explainers on self-driving vehicles in the UK, from YA Transit (Yorkshire Autonomous Transit Ltd).

item.title: When will driverless taxis come to York, Leeds and Manchester?
item.dc:creator: YA Transit
item.description: Where the UK’s self-driving rules stand in October 2026, what has to happen before a driverless taxi can carry passengers in the North, and why London is going first.

item.title: The Automated Vehicles Act explained in plain English
item.dc:creator: YA Transit
item.description: What the Automated Vehicles Act 2024 says about self-driving cars: the self-driving test, who is responsible, what happens to the person in the driving seat, marketing rules and passenger permits.

item.title: Who’s building self-driving cars for UK roads?
item.dc:creator: YA Transit
item.description: A plain-English round-up of the companies testing or planning self-driving vehicles in the UK as of October 2026: Wayve and Uber, Waymo, Baidu, Oxa and Tesla.
